recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-era psychedelic album cover featuring a central photographic portrait of three individuals in formal vintage attire, framed by oversized, ornate Art Nouveau-inspired custom lettering and intricate floral line-art flourishes on a muted sage-green background.
coreVisualRelationships: Interplay between high-contrast photography and flat, illustrative graphic elements
Integration of subjects within the negative spaces of large-scale lettering
Contrast between the eccentric central figure and the stoic flanking figures
Harmonious blend of muted olive, ochre, and sky blue tones
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all illustrative elements
Muted, slightly desaturated color palette with a vintage patina
Symmetrical framing of the central subject by the outer figures
Intricate, thin-line floral scrollwork in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures seated in the lower two-thirds; the central figure is elevated and slightly smaller in scale, creating a triangular focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a bright blue jacket serves as the primary color anchor against the muted surroundings.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top lettering, move down to the central figure, then outward to the flanking seated figures, following the curves of the graphic flourishes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third is dominated by dense, illustrative typography, while the bottom is grounded by a textured rug pattern.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sage green background providing a neutral, vintage base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Ochre and orange-yellow for the large-scale lettering outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sky blue on the central figure's jacket to draw immediate attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black outlines and the pale fill colors.

letterConstructionRules: High-contrast stroke widths with thick outer borders
Internal decorative patterns (floral or geometric) within the letter bodies
Curvilinear, liquid-like flow following the 1960s psychedelic style
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'M' and 'Y' feature long, sweeping descenders that frame the subjects
Numbers are encased in decorative circular or wing-like frames

treatment.fill: Flat cream or ochre with internal patterns

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair massive custom display lettering with tiny, clean sans-serif for technical metadata.

preserve: The integration of text and floral line-art

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn psychedelic energy of the era.
Provides the Art Nouveau skeleton for the letterforms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A vintage studio portrait of three people: a man in a blue jacket holding a ukulele sitting on a table, flanked by an elderly man in a suit and an elderly woman in a striped dress. The background is a flat sage green with intricate, thin black line-art floral flourishes and a textured rug on the floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add massive, custom Art Nouveau psychedelic lettering across the top and sides. The letters should have thick black outlines, ochre fills, and bulbous terminals, curving around the heads of the subjects.

verificationChecks: Lettering follows a psychedelic, hand-drawn aesthetic
Color palette remains muted and vintage
Floral flourishes are thin-line and Victorian in style
Central figure in blue is the primary focal point

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the internal patterns within the lettering
Degree of warping in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals

mustAchieve: Fluid integration of text and image
avoid: Generic 'retro' filters that lack line-art detail

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lettering feels like a physical part of the illustration, not a digital sticker.
Check that the muted green background doesn't wash out the subjects.
Verify the 'triangular' composition of the three figures is maintained.
Confirm the line-art flourishes are delicate and do not overwhelm the main subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a formal vintage photographic portrait with massive, hand-drawn Art Nouveau display type and intricate floral line-art, all unified by a muted, 1960s-inspired earth-tone palette.
